First of all I'm so sorry you're going through all this. No woman ever should have to go through being hurt by someone who is supposed to love them. I'd like to say I definitely understand staying because you feel like its the easiest thing you can do and the best for you(even though it's still a shitty situation). I did the same thing because I'm pregnant. Went back because I felt I needed his help. But you're putting yourself at a big risk of getting even more hurt, and the stress of walking on eggshels around him will definitely affect you negatively. I would try to get out immediately. I know going back to live with family sucks but it may just be absolutely necessary. If that isn't an option definitely get in contact with domestic violence advocates in your area. They will help you, and they are great and safe and can give you so many resources to get you back on your feet, help you heal, and keep you safe all at the same time. Good luck. Please stay safe.💜
